{'《足球教練》(Ted Lasso) 今晚強勢回歸第四季,勢必再掀熱潮。不過最新數據顯示,Apple TV+ 今年至今最受歡迎的劇集,原來同樣出自這位創作人之手。': "《足球教練》(Ted Lasso) makes its highly anticipated return tonight for its fourth season, and it's sure to make waves once again. However, according to the latest data, the most popular show on Apple TV+ so far this year also comes from the same creator."}

{'《好好過日子》(Shrinking) 是 Apple TV+ 2026 年至今收視最高的劇集,數據來自尼爾森。': '《好好過日子》(Shrinking) is the most-watched series on Apple TV+ so far in 2026, according to Nielsen data.'}

{'Apple TV+ 從不公布旗下劇集和電影的官方收視數字。不過,密切留意每日更新的十大排行榜,亦可大致掌握觀眾的收看偏好。': 'Apple TV+ has never released official viewership numbers for its shows and films. However, by keeping a close eye on the daily updated top 10 charts, you can get a fairly good sense of what audiences are tuning in for.'}

{'串流影音業界一向不公開實際觀看數據屬慣常做法。但在眾多試圖量度收視的第三方機構中,尼爾森一直以來都是業界公認的黃金標準。': "It's standard practice in the streaming industry not to disclose actual viewership figures. Among the many third-party organizations that attempt to measure viewership, Nielsen has long been regarded as the industry's gold standard."}

{'尼爾森早前公布了 2026 年上半年的數據,涵蓋各大串流平台的收視情況。': 'Nielsen recently released data covering the first half of 2026, with viewership figures across major streaming platforms.'}

{'Apple TV+ 的節目鮮少躋身尼爾森排行榜,但有一部劇集——《好好過日子》,由《足球教練》的聯合創作人打造——剛好打入「原創劇集」類別的前 20 名。': 'Apple TV+ programs rarely make it onto Nielsen\'s charts, but one series — 《好好過日子》, created by a co-creator of 《足球教練》 — has just squeaked into the top 20 in the "original series" category.'}

{"所謂「原創劇集」,是指由串流平台原創推出的作品。因此像《實習醫生》(Grey's Anatomy) 和《宅男行不行》(The Big Bang Theory) 這些擁有龐大片庫的經典劇集,並不符合資格。": 'By "original series," it means works originally produced by a streaming platform. That\'s why long-running classics with massive libraries like 《實習醫生》(Grey\'s Anatomy) and 《宅男行不行》(The Big Bang Theory) don\'t qualify.'}

{'《好好過日子》在尼爾森榜上排名第二十,累計觀看時數達 52 億分鐘,成為 Apple TV+ 今年播出的劇集中收視之冠。': '《好好過日子》 ranks No. 20 on the Nielsen chart, with a cumulative 5.2 billion minutes viewed, making it the most-watched series Apple TV+ has aired this year.'}

{'該劇與《Love Is Blind》和《Paradise》等同樣錄得約 50 億分鐘的劇集叮噹馬頭。若收視稍為上升,排名本可攀升至第十四位。': 'The show is neck-and-neck with series like Love Is Blind and Paradise, which also racked up around 5 billion minutes. A slight bump in viewership could have pushed its ranking up to No. 14.'}

{'《怪奇物語》(Stranger Things) 和《The Pitt》分別以 230 億及 210 億分鐘的觀看量,佔據排行榜首兩位。': '《怪奇物語》(Stranger Things) and The Pitt took the top two spots, with 23 billion and 21 billion minutes watched respectively.'}

{'對於 Apple TV+ 的劇集來說,能夠打入尼爾森榜已是一大成就。《足球教練》全新一季幾乎肯定亦會在榜上名列前茅。而對 Apple(以及觀眾)而言,好消息是《好好過日子》預計將於明年回歸,推出第四季。': 'For an Apple TV+ series, simply making it onto the Nielsen chart is quite an achievement. The new season of 《足球教練》 will almost certainly rank highly as well. And the good news for Apple (and viewers) is that 《好好過日子》 is expected to return next year with its fourth season.'}

{'尼爾森的收視排名有令你感到意外嗎?歡迎在留言區告訴我們。': "Did any of Nielsen's viewership rankings surprise you? Let us know in the comments."}

{'Apple TV+ 月費為 12.99 美元,亦可透過 Apple One 組合訂閱享有折扣優惠。': 'Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, and you can also subscribe at a discounted rate through the Apple One bundle.'}
